title: An investigation becomes a saved tool
scenario: I10 / named cohort, explicit fits and residuals, alternatives, fixed panel, reopen

slides.caption: Normal native entry
slides.expected: Fresh sensor workbench; no cohort or fitted model.
slides.observed: Fresh sensor workbench; no cohort or fitted model.

slides.caption: Name, collect and fit
slides.action: Edit name and hypothesis, click Collect, then Fit linear.
slides.expected: I20 collects six stable IDs; slope 16, SSE 149.333 and signed residuals.
slides.observed: I20 collects six stable IDs; slope 16, SSE 149.333 and signed residuals.

slides.caption: Rejected numeric edit
slides.action: Enter oops for c0 and click Apply coefficients.
slides.expected: Visible error; the previous model and residuals remain intact.
slides.observed: Visible error; the previous model and residuals remain intact.

slides.caption: Compare identical observations
slides.action: Click Compare alternatives and resize to 980 by 800 points.
slides.expected: Mean, linear and quadratic list parameter counts and training SSE on the same cohort; all remain above status.
slides.observed: Mean, linear and quadratic list parameter counts and training SSE on the same cohort; all remain above status.

slides.caption: Choose another explicit model
slides.expected: Coefficients 68, -2, 2 and zero residuals on the synthetic cohort.
slides.observed: Coefficients 68, -2, 2 and zero residuals on the synthetic cohort.

slides.caption: Edit the model
slides.action: Enter c0=69, verify Save refuses the pending edit, then Apply coefficients.
slides.expected: Six residuals of -1; SSE 6. The alternatives remain separately fitted.
slides.observed: Six residuals of -1; SSE 6. The alternatives remain separately fitted.

slides.caption: Filter and reorder
slides.action: Filter the table to >=70 and reverse its order.
slides.expected: Membership, coefficients and fitted data remain unchanged.
slides.observed: Membership, coefficients and fitted data remain unchanged.

slides.caption: Frozen membership
slides.expected: 207 becomes visible but stays outside the frozen cohort; the old fit is invalidated.
slides.observed: 207 becomes visible but stays outside the frozen cohort; the old fit is invalidated.

slides.caption: Live membership
slides.action: Switch membership to live and fit quadratic.
slides.expected: 207 enters the cohort through I20; the fit and residuals use seven observations.
slides.observed: 207 enters the cohort through I20; the fit and residuals use seven observations.

slides.caption: Extract and save a fixed panel
slides.action: Restore baseline readings, freeze IDs, fit quadratic, apply c0=69, then Save fixed panel.
slides.expected: Compact panel records cohort, provenance, target, coefficients, refit and coefficient controls.
slides.observed: Compact panel records cohort, provenance, target, coefficients, refit and coefficient controls.

slides.caption: Narrow native layout
slides.action: Resize the actual window to 980 by 800 points.
slides.expected: Saved panel and its controls remain visible and clickable.
slides.observed: Saved panel and its controls remain visible and clickable.

slides.caption: Reopen and inspect internals
slides.action: Refit at the narrow size, Reopen the saved panel, Open investigation internals, focus the table filter button, then press F2.
slides.expected: Saved c0=69 is restored first; F2 outside text editing re-collects the same stable IDs and invalidates the old fit.
slides.observed: Saved c0=69 is restored first; F2 outside text editing re-collects the same stable IDs and invalidates the old fit.

slides.caption: Reopen in a new process
slides.action: Launch the same no-argument executable again and click Reopen panel.
slides.expected: Name, hypothesis, frozen IDs, fixture, quadratic model and edited c0=69 survive process exit.
slides.observed: Name, hypothesis, frozen IDs, fixture, quadratic model and edited c0=69 survive process exit.

slides.caption: Saved refit control
slides.action: Click Refit quadratic in the reopened panel.
slides.expected: The intended six sensor observations produce 68, -2, 2 and zero residuals.
slides.observed: The intended six sensor observations produce 68, -2, 2 and zero residuals.

slides.caption: Saved coefficient control
slides.action: Change c1 to -1 and click Apply coefficients.
slides.expected: The intended observations produce SSE 139; this edit is unsaved.
slides.observed: The intended observations produce SSE 139; this edit is unsaved.

slides.caption: Reject an incompatible panel
slides.action: In a fresh workbench fit linear, then Reopen an unsupported panel version.
slides.expected: The error is visible and the current investigation is unchanged.
slides.observed: The error is visible and the current investigation is unchanged.

slides.caption: Preserve state after a save failure
slides.action: Fit linear and Save where panel.json is a directory.
slides.expected: Atomic write fails visibly; the investigation and existing destination survive.
slides.observed: Atomic write fails visibly; the investigation and existing destination survive.

backend: Moxi AppKit / moxi_plot / live NSWindow content-view capture
role: local synthetic fixture; no external accounts
